Status: sessions complete 1, 2, 3; sessions pending none; M3-09 protocol recheck within the protocol-matched range

## Question

Do the selected conclusion-bearing M2/M3 timing results and mapped deterministic results still support the claims in the M0–M3 reports?

## Method

The frozen conclusion set is [`m5_05_conclusions.toml`](m5_05_conclusions.toml). Each timing stage runs its committed measurement example with A-5 sampling; every timing DVC output has a Git summary and a raw output directory. This report reads only Git summaries, not DVC raw paths. Historical values are extracted from the named reports by [m5_05.py](../../analysis/simciv_analysis/m5_05.py). Session cell data and timing are collected in the summaries under `docs/data/m5_05/`.

## M3-09 ratio diagnosis

### Absolute numerator and denominator decomposition

Values are µs/tick. Numerator is the M3P incremental-topology runner; denominator is M3 at the same live population. The historical and current absolute paths are extracted from [M3-09 report](../../docs/reports/M3_09_INCREMENTAL_TOPOLOGY.md) and [M5-05 summary](../data/m5_05/m3_09_incremental_equal_live/summary.json). New runner timings come from [m5_05_m3_09_revision.rs](../../crates/sim-model/examples/m5_05_m3_09_revision.rs).

## M3-09 protocol scope recheck

The recovered helper source at `docs/data/m5_recovered/recovered/session-history/C/AI/SimulaCiv/crates/sim-model/examples/m3p_09_followup_measure.rs:16,309-478` confirms the checkpoint run executes 401 days from the initial state through day 400, then restores each runner from that checkpoint. Its sample function makes one public API call for three consecutive days (lines 343–428). The paired schedule runs 13 iterations, discards the first two as warmups, retains 11 samples, and rotates runner order (lines 431–456); the non-interleaved schedule runs runners sequentially (lines 459–478). Recovered command output at `docs/data/m5_recovered/recovered/session-extracts.jsonl:148-151` records paired and non-interleaved runner medians. The recovered output does not print a ratio field; the report ratios are calculated from those medians.

The committed M5-05 driver constructs its checkpoint with `m3p_checkpoint` in [m5_05_sessions23.rs](../../crates/sim-model/examples/m5_05_sessions23.rs). Its cursor is 400, so its three-day call covers days 400, 401, 402 and includes compaction day 400. For the 100k cell, the M5-05 timing protocol was: “2 warmups; 41 A-5 samples; three-day calls; 7 repetitions per sample; M3P incremental/M3 pair only; contexts built outside each timer.” The 10k selected cell used 24 repetitions per sample. Both methods call each public runner once per three simulated days; M5-05 repeats that operation to meet A-5 sample duration, so validation cadence per simulated day is equal. Other differences are the checkpoint/day boundary and compaction, three-runner rotation versus a two-path pair, 11 versus 41 measured samples, and one operation versus repeated operations per sample. The historical report does not record process priority or affinity, so those controls cannot be compared. The configs, seed, replicate, metrics/events setting, snapshots-off setting, and serial execution mode match.
| measurement                   | checkpoint / timed days                             | compaction | warmups / samples | public calls / sample                    | timed runners                                         | context timing                         |
| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| M3-09 follow-up as documented | executed days 0–400; cursor 401; timed days 401–403 | none       | 2 / 11            | one call per runner; 3 days each         | M3P serial → M3P incremental → M3 (rotating)          | contexts built outside sample timer    |
| M5-05 selected cell           | cursor 400; 400, 401, 402                           | 400        | 2 / 41            | 7 repeated calls per runner; 3 days each | M3P incremental ↔ M3; M3P serial used only for parity | contexts built before each call timer  |
| Protocol-matched A-5 recheck  | cursor 401; 401, 402, 403                           | none       | 2 / 41            | r calls per runner; 3 days each          | M3P serial → M3P incremental → M3 (rotating)          | contexts built outside each call timer |

The original equal-live definition is preserved: M3 starts from the same live M3P agent records and settlement state, while its graph is profile-specific. The matched data uses the same config, seed, replicate, action settings, metrics/events, and serial execution on both revisions. ## Findings

- [exploratory] Selected path ratios are flagged when the absolute deviation exceeds {{< meta ratio_flag_threshold_percent >}}%; the flag does not determine the conclusion status.
- [exploratory] The deterministic test-result table records pass for every target; see [Deterministic confirmations](#deterministic-confirmations).
- [exploratory] Every pre-registered timing stage has a recorded summary.
- [exploratory] The first pre-registered source change was `78181e21aad0733189450b77eb07ee8bc4708377` in the Phase 9B incremental append path; see the cross-revision table.
- [pre-registered: M5-05-M3-09-PROTOCOL-RECHECK] The M5-05 cursor-400 all-days ratio differs by more than the registered 20% band from the historical 100k equal-live ratio; its protocol includes a compaction day.
- [pre-registered: M5-05-M3-09-PROTOCOL-RECHECK] The protocol-matched 100k ratios fall within the pre-registered band around the M3-09 follow-up value; see the scope table.
- [pre-registered: M5-05-M3-09-PROTOCOL-RECHECK] The committed M5-05 cursor sample includes a compaction day; see the scope table.
- [exploratory] The validation method and zero-day public-call timings are reported separately from A-5 full-tick samples.

## Limits

- Session 1 uses representative cells; M2-02 and other historical grid aggregates remain inconclusive from samples.
- Timing is specific to the recorded reference host and A-5 sampling protocol.
- No raw DVC object is needed to run `just check`; summaries are the only report inputs.
